q26_region_map.basis: Coordinator decision Q26: a form region maps to a body_region value only when it lies within it (mouth, nose, brain: head; throat, cervical spine: neck; lumbar spine: back; kidney: flank; pelvis: abdomen; lower extremity: legs; upper extremity: the part it names). Applied on top of the enum candidates; a region not listed here adds nothing.
